I haven't booked anything yet because I couldn't work out which hotel is Dana's usual one in New York.

**The problem:** Dana Lee's reservation history is empty, including cancelled bookings. Nothing on record shows which hotel she usually uses. I didn't want to guess and put a stay at the wrong hotel on the corporate card.

**Flight:** The cheapest nonstop from SFO to JFK on 2026-11-12 is **F100 at $289** (4 seats left). A cheaper $199 flight (F120) has one stop, so it doesn't qualify.

**Hotels with rooms for 2 nights from 2026-11-12:**
| Hotel | Rate per night | Hotel total | Trip total with F100 |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 – Midtown Lodge | $189 | $378 | $667 |
| H2 – Harbor Inn | $239 | $478 | $767 |
| H3 – Plaza Grand | $459 | $918 | **$1,207** |

**To finish, I need:** the name of Dana's usual hotel. If it's Midtown Lodge or Harbor Inn, I'll book it together with F100 right away. If it's Plaza Grand, the trip comes to more than $1,000, so it needs manager approval under company policy before I can book. If her usual hotel isn't on this list, it has no rooms for these dates, and you'll need to choose another one.

Prices and seat counts can change, so I'll check them again before booking.

trace.message: Dana always stays at the Harbor Inn (hotel H2).
